<reason>Both sides argued at a high level with real clash. A landed the debate's sharpest single hit: the dilemma that conditioning parentage recognition either manufactures the stranded infant PRO opened on, or is merely advisory — and A's pressure question forced B to concede "the baby gets citizenship anyway" and that accreditation "certifies structure, not virtue." A's legitimation frame ("protections selective, legitimation universal") was original and never squarely answered. But B absorbed both concessions honestly and turned them: shield-the-infant/sanction-the-adults is A's own formula, friction plus parental liability plus prosecution of the agency where it banks still shifts the pre-conception arithmetic, and the minimum-wage analogy makes "structure not virtue" a reason to regulate rather than abstain. Decisively, B exposed a real wobble in A's counterfactual: A oscillated between abolition (approving that intercountry adoption "cleaned up" by collapsing volumes) and legality-with-liability ("refuse the stamp, keep the liability"), and never rebutted the relocation argument from the opening. B's safe-harbour/licence distinction answer from A was thoughtful but conceded that standards are being enforced anyway, just without gatekeeping. B's closing then crystallized the timing frame — conditions of entry arrive before conception, A's remedies all arrive after the harm — using A's own week-twenty concession against it. A had the last word and largely ignored that frame, re-running legitimation instead. Add three clipped over-length A turns (including an opening that cut off at its crux) as an execution cost, and B built the cleaner, better-defended path.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's pressure Q1 forcing B to choose between stranding the infant and an advisory sanction was the debate's best question, and it extracted a damaging concession. But B's answer — shield the infant, sanction the adults, price the non-compliant lane at litigation plus prosecution, which is CON's own formula — plus the closing turn that A's week-twenty timing point indicts A's own ex-post remedies, was the most decisive rebuttal of the exchange.</best_rebuttal>
